title: Ski-Touring & Splitboarding in Banff: Private
includes: Personal gear (list to be provided) (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Banff National Park backcountry on touring skis or a splitboard with certified Guides. 

With years of training and expertise in the local area, our ACMG guides will lead you to the best touring locations, with safety as a primary concern on any given day. 

Learn from the local experts and ski/ride some epic powder!
